consent.title: Shoulder blade check (optional)
consent.warning: This step needs a clear view of your shoulder blades: take your shirt off or wear a sports bra or a top that leaves your upper back bare. You'll take one photo from behind and a short video of you raising and lowering your arms. Do it somewhere private, and only if you're comfortable.
consent.kept: The photo and video are analysed to measure your shoulder blades. Only those measurements are saved; the photo and video are deleted unless you choose to keep them.
consent.decline: You can skip this step. Your workout analysis still runs, just without shoulder-blade predictions.
